audit_title: Universal Motion Canvas Scene Builder V4 - Upstream Integration Audit

b4-runtime.mjs.reason: Adapt audio track timing, voice lead/tail margins, and audio ducking into Motion Canvas timeline audio synchronization.

b3-graphics.mjs.reason: Merge vector shape primitives (path, rect, ellipse, strokes) into Motion Canvas 2D Node components (@motion-canvas/2d).

autopilot-render.mjs.reason: Adapt keyframing logic and layer rendering into Motion Canvas signals, tweens, and reactive properties; replace raw canvas loop with Motion Canvas generator flow.

autopilot-core.mjs.reason: Extract strict project validation, shot continuity constraints (3s shot pacing), and font loading conventions into ProductionScenePackage validator.

b4-production-check.mjs.reason: Reuse automated QA checks (caption bounds, no silent opening, first-frame sound, no abrupt volume spikes) as post-render verification.

a6_finish.py / a6_reference_check.py.reason: Reference for Gemini finishing and prompt styling; D:/Agent already has more comprehensive research-grounded fact modeling and Gemini multimodal analysis.

@napi-rs/canvas renderer.reason: Replace 2D raster canvas rendering with Motion Canvas + Three.js hybrid runtime (3D architectural depth + 2D expressive vector stickman).

director_omni_flash_prompts.reason: Project storytelling is first-person roleplay driven by local deterministic scene engine; external prompt-only video generation is not used.

existing_universal_pipeline_python.reason: Python remains the single brain for script intelligence, archival visual facts, character DNA, location DNA, and voice truth.

pycairo_renderer_v3.reason: PyCairo produces paper textures, authentic archival map layers, documents, and reference sheets consumed by Motion Canvas.

motion_canvas_core_and_2d.reason: Motion Canvas v3.17.2 powers scene orchestration, reactive stickman animation, camera choreography, and multi-track audio sync.

threejs_world_adapter.reason: Three.js provides 3D spatial architecture (Odeonsplatz Feldherrnhalle loggia, stone columns, perspective camera, volumetric lighting) without redrawing backgrounds per camera angle.
